text:
Nora: Need a sharp one-pager to send in the webinar follow-up. Audience = platform security + procurement. Must include a short decision strip (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), two safe benchmark callouts (no raw numbers), and a gated lead-routing CTA so SDRs can classify inbound. Keep it single-column and scannable.
Eli: I can draft. Idea: call it 'Deployment Compass'  three stacked cards with a one-line 'When to pick' and a tiny 3-row micro-compare (Security | SLA | Typical buyer). Add a 3-question SDR signal block so leads route correctly.
Jamal: Agree. Tone: buyer-first, not product manual. For benchmarks use phrasing like 'low p95 latency profiles' and 'meaningful unit-cost improvements with batching/quantization; workload dependent.' Cite benchmark hub MB-2026-04 rather than numbers.
Priya: Security notes: do not name KMS vendors, avoid promising turnkey air-gapped installs unless Ops validates. Safe line: 'Configurable networking, KMS integrations, and audit logging.' Add legal footnote: 'Performance varies by model, hardware, and prompt patterns.'
Ops-Bot: Reminder: any benchmark reference must include MB-2026-04 link and Ops sign-off. Tag @ops in final PDF before publish.
Eli: Draft copy below. Please flag edits.

```
Deployment Compass  pick the deployment that matches your controls

Hosted  Fastest path to validation
- Why: API-first hosted inference for rapid experiments and early rollouts.
- Security: Shared infra with tenant isolation and RBAC.
- When to pick: quick prototyping, limited compliance needs.

Dedicated  Predictable throughput & SLAs
- Why: Reserved GPU pools with configurable autoscaling for steady production.
- Security: Data-isolated capacity and stronger access controls.
- When to pick: scaling products that need guaranteed throughput.

Private  Compliance-first control
- Why: VPC or on-prem deployment options with audit logging and customer KMS integrations.
- Security: Network isolation and enterprise policy enforcement.
- When to pick: regulated or security-sensitive workloads.

At-a-glance (Security | SLA | Typical buyer)
- Hosted: Shared controls | Best-effort latency | Product experiments
- Dedicated: Isolated pools | SLA-backed | Growing production teams
- Private: Full control | Configurable SLAs | Regulated enterprises

Benchmarks: See MB-2026-04 (benchmark hub) for latency profiles by model & region and cost comparison notes. Performance varies by model, hardware, and prompt patterns.

SDR signal tags (quick):
- Data residency required? [Yes / No]
- SLA required? [Yes / No]
- Peak throughput band: [Low / Mid / High]

Routing CTA: Book a deployment review (shortlink: redwood.ai/route)  gated intake captures SDR signals and routes to Hosted / Dedicated / Private lanes.

Legal footnote: Performance and unit costs vary by model, hardware, and workload. Contact Sales for private deployment packaging; options vary by customer.
```

Nora: Nice. Edit: change 'Peak throughput band' labels to '<2k | 2k-20k | >20k' to match SDR categories. Also shorten header to 'Deployment Compass: choose your path'.
Jamal: Also replace '\u007f' characters with simple bullets/dashes in the final PDF layout.
Priya: Approved on security text with Ops caveats. Please remove any direct vendor claims.
Ops-Bot: Added @ops to reviewers. Will review MB-2026-04 link and confirm wording.
Eli: I'll update copy and post a PDF draft in this thread tomorrow AM. Owner: Eli. Reviewers: @Nora, @Priya, @ops. Timeline: draft AM, final by EOD Friday. Thanks!
